remarks_1999: Backing inscriptions 1 and 4 date 1920? Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Dated 1920 on basis of backing inscriptions 1 and 4. Too many works are inscribed with the O'Keeffe star to allow it to carry the meaning assigned in backing inscription 6. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: White flowers with pointy petals sit against a cluster of dark green pine needles. Angular green stems just out throughout the composition. A sprig of red leaves sits on the righthand side of the image.
